name: 受信箱・Planner・Board・ボード切替を持つフローティングナビゲーション
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Trello floating navigation bar as a Japanese-localized UI crop at exactly 575x54 px, 10.65:1. Preserve the short horizontal pill shape and the source's dark surface. Keep all four items, icons, labels, selected state, and divider visible within the shallow bar.

From left to right, show: an Inbox tray icon with 「受信箱」; a calendar icon with 「プランナー」; a board-columns icon with 「ボード」 in the selected state; a thin vertical divider; and a stacked-board switch icon with 「ボードを切り替え」. Keep the same compact horizontal spacing and the relative item order and size from the reference. Use a rounded dark-charcoal container, subtle outline and soft shadow. Normal items use muted light-gray text and consistent thin outline icons. The selected Board item sits on a restrained medium-blue rounded highlight, with blue text/icon and a short blue underline visible along its lower edge.

Use compact, readable Japanese sans typography at about 14 px and balanced icon strokes around 18 px. Keep every label on one line, especially 「ボードを切り替え」. Preserve the source's dark/blue palette and quiet depth. Do not add a page, browser frame, extra navigation, logos, additional icons, or other text. Match the original 575x54 crop bounds and ensure no part of the bar is clipped.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against the exact 575x54 Trello floating-navigation crop. Inbox, Planner, selected Board, divider, and Switch boards are complete and in order; Japanese labels are one line. Icon positions, selected blue highlight/underline, and compact spacing align closely. Raw 2095x751 output was framed to 2095x197 (aspect ratio within 0.13% of source) and proportionally resized to 575x54. The outer rim and shadow are slightly stronger than the source.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
